newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia 1st qtr gold output down 3 pct-Macquarie.
newsitem.headline: Australia 1st qtr gold output down 3 pct-Macquarie.

text.p: Overall Australian gold production declined three percent in the quarter ended March 31 to 70.1 tonnes, although output among the top 10 producers rose seven percent, Macquarie Equites Ltd said in a report on Monday.

Abnormally high rainfall in northern Western Australia, the Northern Territory and Queensland resulted in a seven percent drop in tonnes of ore treated to extract the gold content over the same period, when compared to the previous quarter, Macquarie said.
But average ore grades treated rose four percent to 1.85 grams a tonne, despite operating problems at many mines.
